Statistics of [[Belgian First Division]] in the 1913–14 season.

It was contested by 12 teams, and [[R. Daring Club Molenbeek|Daring Club]] won the championship.<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |title=Belgium – Final Tables 1895–2008 |publisher=The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |last1=Ploquin |first1=Phil |last2=Nackaerts |first2=Luc |last3=Coolsaet |first3=Jeroen |access-date=16 December 2018}}</ref>

Because they finished level on points in 10th/11th place, [[K.A.A. Gent|A.A. La Gantoise]] and [[Standard Liège|Standard Club Liégeois]] played a Test Match to decide who would stay up: this was won by La Gantoise, thus relegating Liégeois to the Promotion Division.
